text:
Jess: FYI customer reported embedding usage mismatch — dashboard shows ~700k embedding inputs for Feb, invoice shows 1.1M. They're asking for a breakdown and repro steps. CSV attached.
Kevin: can you share the CSV sample (first 50 lines) + their account id? we need to correlate usage_id.
Jess: account_id=A-0192, csv excerpt pasted in thread.
Maria: quick glance — I see lots of empty strings in the csv and a few rows with long text (newlines). could be truncation/dup drops during ingestion. :thinking:
Arjun: two likely suspects: 1) CSV import path duplicates rows when values contain unescaped newlines, resulting in extra blank inputs. 2) rerank/pairwise style requests might be double-counted if we record per-pair and also per-source item.
Jess: customer claims they used the batch embeddings endpoint with an array of inputs. they didn't call rerank. they did upload CSV via Console -> Upload -> import as "bulk embeddings".
infra-bot: ingest-service created job job-7753 for A-0192 at 2024-11-02T14:12:05Z (link: https://internal/jobs/job-7753) :eyes:
Kevin: invoice shows 1,103,412 embedding units billed for period. Dashboard usage API returns 694,112. That's the exact gap the customer sees.
Maria: can someone try to repro with a synthetic CSV that has newline-containing fields and empty lines? quick test locally might show whether upload client splits lines incorrectly.
Arjun: repro steps I used locally:
```
# simulate console upload: create csv with embedded newlines and empty rows
cat > test.csv <<EOF
id,text
1,"short"
2,"line1\nline2"
3,""
4,"long text \n with newline"

EOF
# call internal ingestion CLI
./bin/ingest --account A-0192 --file test.csv --mode embeddings --dry-run
```
Arjun: result: ingest CLI produced 6 input records (expected 4) because the newline-containing fields were split into additional rows by the parser. The extra blank row was converted to an empty-string input and counted. :exclamation:
Jess: nice, can you paste the exact parser lib/version? customer used chrome upload; we need to know if frontend or backend is the culprit.
Arjun: parser is csv-parse v4.3.1 in the console backend. The CLI uses the same codepath. Root cause: we pass { relax_column_count: true } in streaming parser, which allows unbalanced quotes to create new records instead of throwing. In combination with our post-processing that trims rows, empty rows end up counted but the dashboard dedup/cleanup path later filters them out; invoice pipeline counts raw ingestion rows.
Kevin: so two different pipelines — dashboard applies post-cleaning (filters empty) but billing job uses raw ingest count. That's why invoice > dashboard. Ugh.
Maria: proposed mitigation: patch ingestion to drop empty-string inputs before persisting and re-run billing aggregator for affected window OR issue customer credit. Also add validation on frontend upload to reject files with unescaped newlines.
Kevin: agree. For immediate customer response: 1) explain root cause, 2) run quick aggregation patch to correct counts for A-0192 between 2024-01-01 and 2024-02-28, 3) offer provisional credit while we backfill. I'll coordinate with finance. :+1:
Jess: I'll reply to customer with reproduction and ETA. Could you assign an owner for the code fix and a PR ETA?
Arjun: i'll own the parser fix. plan: remove relax_column_count and add explicit row-validation -> PR by EOD tomorrow. I'll add unit tests for multiline fields and empty-row trimming.
infra-bot: deploy pipeline notice: canary rollout scheduled for parser-fix branch after PR merge.
Kevin: I'll open a billing ticket for the backfill/credit and put it on high priority. finance lead cc'd.
Jess: customer updated — appreciates quick detection, asking for final counts after fix. I'll keep them posted.
Maria: after fix, we should add an alert when invoice-dashboard delta > 5% for embedding usage per-account. catching early would have flagged this.
Arjun: noted. will add metric to telemetry board (embedding.billing.delta).
Jess: closing loop — will update thread when billing action done. Thanks all :heart:
